copy.tagline: 对Axone合约应用领域驱动设计模式
copy.tagline_en: Apply domain-driven design patterns to Axone contracts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are doing domain-driven design on Axone contracts

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你把业务规则封装到专门的领域层（domain/）中，而不是分散在处理、查询或存储代码里。它建议使用构造函数（如 new、try_new）来拒绝无效数据。
howto.when: 当你在设计 Axone 合约时，引入领域概念、编码不变约束，或决定 domain、handlers、services、gateways、queries、state 等层的边界时触发。

say.text: 帮我为一个合约设计领域模型，划分各层职责。
say.note: Claude 会按边界规则给出建议。

say.text: 我想把业务规则封装到 domain 层，该怎么实现？
say.note: Claude 会推荐构造函数和 TryFrom 模式。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you to encapsulate business invariants in a dedicated domain layer (domain/) instead of scattering them across handlers, queries, or storage. It recommends using constructors like new or try_new to reject invalid states early.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you are designing an Axone contract, introducing domain concepts, encoding invariants, or deciding boundaries between domain, handlers, services, gateways, queries, and state.

say_en.text: Help me design a domain model for a contract and define layer boundaries.
say_en.note: Claude provides recommendations based on boundary rules.

say_en.text: I want to encapsulate business logic in domain types. How?
say_en.note: Claude suggests constructors and TryFrom patterns.
